change: Pages deploys only on a per-tool stable GitHub Release or stable-promotion event. The job validates the exact per-tool tag, checks out the immutable commit associated with that release event, and compares the page manifest to GitHub Release records with explicit draft=false and prerelease=false before artifact upload. Demo-only pushes, manual dispatches, and prereleases cannot deploy.
